evidence.note: Evidence must be in THE LABEL'S OWN text. Words are matched as whole words, case-insensitively; code shapes as written (case-sensitive).

notes.noCode: No model code was read. Type the code from the label (for example SM-A165F).
notes.unclear: The model code could not be read clearly. Check the model.
notes.repaired: The model code was not clearly readable; read as {prefix}{code}. Check the model.
notes.repairedMany: The model code was not clearly readable. Check the model.
notes.disagree: The two model lines disagree ({prefix}{code} / {prefix}{other}). Check the model.
notes.different: Different model codes were read ({codes}). Check the model.
notes.editShape: Not a Samsung model code (for example SM-A165F). Check the model.

imeiRules.evidence: Seen on every label of three Samsung models in the test data (IMEI 1 and IMEI 2 of one device share digits 9 to 14 and differ in the first 8). Not documented by the manufacturer.
imeiRules.note: IMEI 1 was taken from its barcode because its printed number could not be read. Check it against the label.
